# Five-minute user-task demo — proposed

Status: NOT_RUN. Target duration 4:40; verify final encoded duration. No actual feature, AWS execution, user value or learning result is demonstrated yet. Use [A08/A09 and claims C01–C05](../USER-NEEDS-ADOPTION.md) to prepare accurate assets. This script is not publication/submission authority.

Participant: an invited packing operator (P02), with a buyer (P01) and evaluator (P08/P09) inspecting the result. Task: check one supported kit against an approved recipe, resolve ambiguity, inspect evidence and perform the mandatory manual double-check. Identify a team member acting a role as such; no invented customer story. Fulfill or clarify the team appearance requirement; do not assume a title card suffices.

| Time | User task and shot | Evidence and disclosures |
|---|---|---|
| 0:00–0:25 | Team introduction; show ordinary manual/checklist task and intended problem | Describe configured visible checks only; distinguish observed problem evidence from hypothesis |
| 0:25–0:50 | Select qualified recipe/station; preview the transmitted capture rectangle, retained work ROI and expected contents | Disclose calibration/onboarding, preloads, integration, data origin, assistance and live vs recorded capture |
| 0:50–1:50 | Inspect overlap; targeted separation reveals a missing part; correct and reinspect the same kit | Actual finding changes action; no fabricated state. Inspect evidence and manually double-check; no shipping approval |
| 1:50–2:20 | Remove a part or interrupt camera; show expiry/recheck and safe escalation | Show limits, stop/help and fresh-observation requirement; historical result is not current |
| 2:20–2:50 | Show a second ordinary kit or identified repeat-task recording | Record assistance after ordinary onboarding and complete effort, or state repeat value untested |
| 2:50–3:30 | Inspect baseline/adaptive results, adverse cases and cost | Frozen denominators/uncertainty, setup allocation, retakes, manual review, training/support. No invented 20% result; report absent advantage |
| 3:30–4:05 | Show exact OpenCV 5 runtime, AWS execution and concise action/verifier trace | Actual version/target and substantive vision-to-action evidence. Learning/replay or optional COOL only if actually measured; otherwise label untested |
| 4:05–4:40 | Explain fit, buyer commitment, limits and sanitized reproducibility package | Ordinary checking is an alternative. State unresolved conditions and known failures; scope value/adoption claims to actual results |

Freeze build/config/data/mode, task truth and equal action/capture budgets before recording. Compare the strongest applicable baseline. Link full unedited task timing and preparation records even if video compresses time. Do not edit away failures or imply replay measures operator time. If incomplete, label prototype/storyboard footage clearly; it cannot substantiate functioning-project claims or replace required contest evidence.

Label synthetic/printable/physical scenes and acted/actual operators. Distinguish recorded from live capture. Obtain rights/permissions for media and people; use readable captions/overlays. Do not show credentials or personal shipping labels. Spoken numbers require frozen results and exact scope.

In a separate authorized evaluation, ask the participant to explain scope, failure, manual checks, authority and repeat-use needs without leading prompts. Record first/repeat value, assistance and adopt/defer/decline separately. A polished video does not establish comprehension, buyer readiness or sustained use. Submission requirements remain in [hackathon evidence](../HACKATHON-EVIDENCE.md).
